$description: Plinth v1.0 design tokens (W3C DTCG 2025.10 format). Bundle of tokens/*.tokens.json. Generated; do not hand-edit.

preset.$description: Identity-dial presets. A brand profile selects one per dial.

composition.$description: Structural presets; no token values. Selected via data-header / data-hero / data-index and the matching component variant.

ground.$description: lime | ink — selects the semantic mode for the whole site.

brand.$description: Default resolution (literary / laterite / warm / standard / standard). A client profile re-points these aliases; CSS does it via data attributes on <html>.

semantic.$description: Role tokens. Components read only these. Two modes: lime and ink.

type.$description: display-xl / display-l = brand.typeContrast × brand.displayFace.scale (computed in CSS). h1, h2 also × display-scale.
